name: Magic Swords Idle RPG 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Magic Swords Idle RPG is an idle clicker game where you defeat monsters, get gold, and buy and upgrade swords. There are different mechanics in the game, which are:      A building system, where you can build different structures in hell     Pet system     Dungeons, where you can defeat powerful bosses to gain materials to upgrade your artifacts  Gotta click 'em all!
